title: Disposal of Polymers
page_title: Disposal of Polymers | Cambridge (CIE) AS Chemistry Revision Notes 2023

blocks.md:
- Poly(alkenes) are extremely important in everyday life, such as their use as **plastics**
- However, the disposal of these polymers is problematic
- Poly(alkenes) are very large alkane molecules which are **unreactive **and therefore undergo very few chemical reactions (although they do burn); they are **resistant **to **chemical attack**
- Due to their unreactivity, polymers are **non-biodegradable** and take up to hundreds of years to decompose when dumped in landfill sites

  - Throwing away poly(alkenes) therefore causes long-term pollution of the environment
- Burning the polymers results in **harmful** **combustion products **which again cause the pollution of the environment

blocks.label: Exam Hint
blocks.md: The disposal of polymers is a challenge due to their unreactivity, their non-biodegradability, and the formation of harmful combustion products when burnt
